services.name: Museum Rentals
services.desc: Make your next corporate gathering, business or club meeting, holiday party, wedding, or other special event unique and fun by hosting it at the Birthplace of Country Music Museum. You can host your event in the Performance Theater, Atrium, or Learning Center, and you can even give your guests the opportunity to experience the entire museum including the permanent and special exhibits. There is a kitchen available on-site for your catering team, and The Museum Store can also be open during your event.
